title: Great
body: It’s my first time trying a journaling/routine app so I had high expectations and was curious about it. I decided to try it out, and I’m glad I did! The routine was easy enough to make, and the little chirping sound it made when it notified me was super cute. The mental health tests were interesting, and the meditation soundtracks were useful for my relaxation. Also, I liked that it was free, unless you want to subscribe. There’s only one little problem I have about this: I was expecting a lot more aesthetic elements than was given, but not a really big problem and it was easy to dismiss. Overall, it’s a solid 4.8/5 stars for me, and I recommend it for people who struggle to get on task.
